optimizedDescription.value: SDK presentation helpers render compiled change and project context as canonical agent-facing markdown with correct spec load hints.

optimizedContext.value:
# Context Markdown

## Rules

- Export pure synchronous `changeContextToMarkdown(context: CompileContextResult, options: ChangeContextToMarkdownOptions): string`. Options: required `changeName: string`; optional `includeFingerprint: boolean`, default `true`.
- `context.status === 'unchanged'`: include fingerprint line when enabled; include exactly `Context unchanged since last call.`; render no project context/spec catalogues.
- `context.status === 'changed'`: when enabled, first line `Context Fingerprint: <context.contextFingerprint>`. Then project entries separated by `---`: files as `**Source: <path>**` + content; instructions as `**Source: instruction**` + content.
- Full specs: `## Spec content`; each `### Spec: <specId>`, explicit `Mode: full`, then content.
- Non-full (`summary`/`list`) change catalogue: `## Available context specs`; partition/order:
  1. Change specs, `source: 'specIds'`: when non-empty, emit once Use `specd changes spec-preview <changeName> <specId>` to load the merged full content of any change spec you need. then table. These may contain deltas/new specs; canonical context is incorrect.
  2. Other context specs, `source: 'specDependsOn'` or `'includePattern'`: if this or dependency group exists, emit once before first applicable table Use `specd specs context <specId>` to load the full optimized context of any listed spec.; render table when non-empty.
  3. Via dependencies, `source: 'dependsOnTraversal'`: when non-empty, `### Via dependencies` then table; never duplicate specs-context hint.
- Omit empty groups and their hints. Never suggest `spec-preview` outside `source: 'specIds'`. Grouping/hints apply equally to `summary` and `list`.
- Change tables: `summary` columns `| Spec ID | Mode | Source | Title | Description |`; `list` columns `| Spec ID | Mode | Source |`.
- Export pure synchronous `projectContextToMarkdown(context: GetProjectContextResult): string`.
- Project rendering: pre-rendered `context.contextEntries` first, separated by `---`; full specs under `## Spec content` with spec heading, `Mode: full`, content; non-full specs under `## Available context specs` and, when non-empty, exactly Use `specd specs context <specId>` to load the full optimized context of any listed spec.. Never mention `changes spec-preview` or change preview commands. Empty entries and specs returns exactly `no project context configured`.
- Project tables: `summary` columns `| Spec ID | Mode | Title | Description |`; `list` columns `| Spec ID | Mode |`.
- Helpers perform no I/O, kernel access, process effects. Hosts MAY use them for text; hosts emit JSON/TOON from raw results. `CompileContext` owns fingerprint short-circuit; helper only formats received result.
- Place under `packages/sdk/src/presentation/`; re-export through `src/index.ts`. Shared table internals MAY remain non-exported.

## Constraints

- Accept core `CompileContextResult` and `GetProjectContextResult` types already re-exported by `@specd/sdk`.
- Never invent optimized content; format only argument fields.
- Agent hints use plural CLI groups `changes`, `specs`.
- MUST NOT depend on `sdk:composition`; composition exports helpers, presentation does not depend on barrel contract.
